status.en: 9 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 40% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 9 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 40 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi courts sentenced seven French citizens, including six to life, for Islamic State membership, while security forces downed an unidentified drone over Baghdad. Baghdad and the Kurdistan Region deepened security coordination and weapons control, and Iraq announced it will host a 2028 OIC anti-corruption meeting. Prime Minister Al-Zaidi’s visit to Damascus advanced border security talks and oil links, and Turkey welcomed new Iraqi security steps in Sinjar. A sudden ouster of the Iraqi spy chief raised questions about the prime minister’s agenda, and Iraq’s development road plan promises 100,000 jobs. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske domstoler dømte syv franske borgere, hvorav seks fikk livstid, for medlemskap i IS, mens sikkerhetsstyrker skjøt ned en ukjent drone over Bagdad. Bagdad og Kurdistan-regionen styrket sikkerhetskoordineringen og våpenkontrollen, og Irak kunngjorde at de vil være vertskap for et OIC-møte om korrupsjonsbekjempelse i 2028. Statsminister Al-Zaidi besøkte Damaskus og fremmet samtaler om grensesikkerhet og oljelenker, og Tyrkia ønsket de nye irakiske sikkerhetstiltakene i Sinjar velkommen. En plutselig avsettelse av Iraks spionsjef reiste spørsmål om statsministerens agenda, og Iraks utviklingsplan lover 100 000 arbeidsplasser. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
